description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 17.10.2022 to 23.10.2022
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for financial/commercial transactions at customs, falling under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it creates binding compliance requirements for import/export activities. While it mentions the Director General of Customs by name, this is incidental to the regulatory function rather than constituting a personnel appointment with portfolio responsibilities.
